entities.name: Adila Rimheit
entities.description: A priest of the Church of Avacyn on Innistrad who secretly harbored werewolves and sought a cure for lycanthropy.

entities.name: Elsi
entities.description: Adila's red-haired daughter, bitten by a werewolf at age 8 and condemned by the church.

entities.name: Jorgin Rimheit
entities.description: Adila's father, executed for aiding a werewolf.

entities.name: Reika Eberhardt
entities.description: Adila's ward, student and companion, who died mysteriously in Thraben.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church in which Adila holds a high position.

events.summary: Elsi is bitten by a werewolf at age 8; despite Adila's defense she is condemned by the church and dies.
